questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a phrasal verb error.

Mrs. Premlatha asked / Malini to hand down / all the / payment slips.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb in question is "hand down," which means to pass something from one person to another, typically used in contexts like passing knowledge or heirlooms.
 
• In this case, "hand down" is incorrectly used. The correct phrasal verb should be "hand over," which means to give something to someone, typically in an official or formal manner.
 
• The correct phrase should be "Malini to hand over all the payment slips," ensuring grammatical accuracy.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part C** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mrs. Premlatha asked Malini to **hand over** all the payment slips."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "Mrs. Premlatha asked"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **B: "Malini to hand down"** – This is where the error occurs; "hand down" should be replaced with "hand over."
 
• **D: "payment slips"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Cultural heritage is the lifeblood of any _______ and serves as a link between generations.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**civilisation**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**civilisation**" refers to the stage of human social development and organization that is considered advanced. It is the most fitting word in the context of cultural heritage being essential for societal progress.
 
• Cultural heritage is indeed a key element for any society or civilisation as it preserves traditions, customs, and collective memory across generations.
 
• The other options: "**lethargy**," "**birthright**," and "**believe**" do not fit as appropriately as "civilisation." "Lethargy" means sluggishness, "birthright" refers to an inherited right, and "believe" is an abstract verb that does not match the context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Cultural heritage is the lifeblood of any civilisation__ and serves as a link between generations.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lethargy (आलस्य)**: Refers to a state of sluggishness or lack of energy, which is not relevant to the context of cultural heritage.
 
• **Birthright (जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार)**: Refers to an inherited right, which doesn’t fit the context of culture and heritage being central to a society's development.
 
• **Believe (विश्वास)**: This is a verb and doesn’t fit grammatically or contextually with the sentence describing cultural heritage.

questions.question: What does it imply when people say to 'read between the lines'?

options.text: To read with an ability to infer the meaning
To skip initial and final lines in a paragraph

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Read between the lines"** refers to understanding the hidden or implied meaning in what is being said or written. (गूढ़ या छिपे हुए अर्थ को समझना)

 
 
• **Example: **When he said he was "fine," I could read between the lines and tell he was upset.
 
 
 
• **Correct Explanation:** To "read with an ability to infer the meaning" means comprehending not just the surface meaning of the text but also the implicit or underlying message. (अर्थ को समझने की क्षमता के साथ पढ़ना)
 
 
• **Example:** The author never explicitly criticized the government, but you could infer his disapproval by reading between the lines.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To read something fast** (तेज़ी से पढ़ना): Refers to the act of quickly going through written material without focusing on understanding deeper meanings.

 
 
• **Example:** She skimmed the document to read it fast before the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To skip initial and final lines in a paragraph** (अनुच्छेद की प्रारंभिक और अंतिम पंक्तियों को छोड़ना): Refers to ignoring certain parts of a passage, which often leads to missing critical information.
 
 
• **Example:** Skipping lines in the paragraph caused him to miss the most important details.

• **Example:** He avoided detailed information to save time during his research.
